format.description: Format version the card was written with, such as `"1.0"`.

kind.description: What kind of item this card describes.

title.description: Human-readable title (the owner may edit it).

item.description: The item's name relative to the card's folder; required for files, folders and bundles.

sealed.description: How strictly a bundle is protected; required for bundles.

allow_readme.description: For soft-sealed bundles: whether a program may add a `README.md` inside (default `true`).

summary.description: Two or three sentences describing the item.

tags.description: Tags from the vocabularies along the item's path (FORMAT.md §6.5).

sensitivity.description: How carefully the item must be handled.

checksum.description: The file's checksum; required for files.

size.description: Size in bytes; required for files, folders and bundles.

manifest.description: The folder's or bundle's manifest; required for folders and bundles.

location.description: Where the item is, for physical objects and external references.

url.description: The resource's address; required for URL items.

checked_out.description: Present while the item is checked out (FORMAT.md §9.1).

snapshots.description:
When the item's working copy is snapshotted while it's being worked on (FORMAT.md
§5.2); every session unless set.

placement.description: How sure filing was of the item's collection, when it wasn't (FORMAT.md §5.8).

removed.description: Why and when the item was removed; required for tombstones (FORMAT.md §10).

expanded_from.description: The compressed file the item was expanded from (FORMAT.md §5.2).

needs_work.description: The owner's mark that the item or its card needs work (FORMAT.md §5.9).

CardMarker.description: The `carrel: card` marker that identifies a Markdown file as a card (FORMAT.md §5).

oneOf.description: The only value.

Id.description: A permanent identifier: a UUID, which FORMAT.md §2.3 requires to be version 7.

oneOf.description: A single file.
A folder whose contents programs may reorganize with approval.
A folder stored and moved whole.
Something outside the archive, such as a book; card only.
A web resource; card only.
A file or folder stored outside the archive; card only.
A record of a removed item; card only.

Sealing.description: How strictly a bundle is protected (FORMAT.md §4.2).

oneOf.description: Never write inside.
Never write inside, except an optional `README.md`.

Tag.description: A tag: lowercase words joined by `-` (FORMAT.md §6.5).

Link.description: A typed link to another item (FORMAT.md §5.4).

type.description: A built-in link type or a custom one declared in `ARCHIVE.md`.

path.description: The target card's path relative to this card, kept current as a convenience.

LinkType.description: A link type. Built-in types are listed in [`LinkType::BUILT_IN`].

modified.description: When the item was last modified.

added.description: When the item was added to the archive.

worked.description: When the item was last worked on.

document.description: The item's own date, such as a publication date.

DateOrTime.description: An ISO 8601 date (`2026-10-29`) or RFC 3339 timestamp with offset (FORMAT.md §2.4).

oneOf.description: Fine to describe anywhere.
The owner's own material.
Needs care before it is described outside the device.
Identity, medical or financial records.

Checksum.description: A checksum written as `algorithm:hex` (FORMAT.md §2.6). Version 1.0 uses SHA-256.

ManifestRef.description: Where a folder's or bundle's manifest is, and its checksum (FORMAT.md §7.7).

to.description: Where the working copy is, on the device that checked it out.

device.description: The device that checked it out.

person.description: The person who checked it out.

due.description: When it is due back, if a due date was set.

manifest.description: The manifest checksum at checkout, for detecting changes on return.

Snapshots.description: When a checked-out or desk item's working copy is snapshotted (FORMAT.md §5.2).

oneOf.description: Only at checkout and return, not after each work session: for large data.

by.description: The program and version, such as `carrel 0.2.0`.

model.description: The model, if one was used.

device.description: The device that produced the fields.

level.description: Whether a stronger device should re-check the result.

drafting.description:
The drafting version that wrote the fields ([`crate::ingest::card::DRAFTING`]):
with `model`, what drafted the card. Unset, an unknown older version.

QualityLevel.description: Whether a result was produced at its task's preferred level.

oneOf.description: Produced at the preferred level.
Produced below it; a stronger device should re-check.

PlacementRecord.description:
How sure filing was of an item's collection, kept when it wasn't sure (FORMAT.md §5.8), as
evidence for restructuring.

PlacementConfidence.description: How sure routing was of a placement worth recording.

oneOf.description: The routing passes disagreed, the model chose Holding, or validation needed a retry.
A model chose it and a second pass agreed.
A text model.
An owner routing rule.

Removal.description: Why and when an item was removed (FORMAT.md §10.1).

former_kind.description: What kind of item it was.

recoverable_from.description: The backup snapshot it can be restored from.

ExpandedFrom.description:
The compressed file an item was expanded from (FORMAT.md §5.2), so it's clear the item
was, say, a zip, and which one.

NeedsWorkForm.description:
The forms `needs_work` may take: `true` (or `false`, the same as leaving it out), a note,
or the whole record.

anyOf.description: Flagged, with what, who and when.

NeedsWork.description:
The owner's mark that an item or a collection needs work (FORMAT.md §5.9), with what, who
and when. Written by hand it may be only `true` or a note; programs write the whole record.

id.description:
The flag's permanent identifier, so what's done about it can name it; kept when its
note changes. Hand-written flags have none until a program rewrites them.

note.description: What needs doing, in a few words, such as "wrong title" or "split this folder".
